Home.title: XHS Content Verifier
Home.tagline: Review Xiaohongshu post text, comments, and images for authenticity.

PostText.title: Post Text
PostText.placeholder: Paste the Xiaohongshu post text here...

Images.title: Post Images
Images.description: Upload the actual image(s) attached to the post for Layer 4 image-text consistency. This is different from the comment screenshot below. Optional; maximum 2 images and 2 MB total.
Images.selectedCount: {count, plural, one {# post image selected} other {# post images selected}}

Comments.title: Comments
Comments.instructions: Choose either option: type comments manually or upload a screenshot of the post's comment section to extract them. Both options add comments to the same list. Review and correct the list, then click the main Analyze button once for the combined report. The comment screenshot is only for Layer 3; upload actual post photos in Images above for Layer 4. Layer 3 needs at least 5 comments to calculate a score; fewer comments can still be submitted but will be marked as insufficient data.

Screenshot.title: Import comments from a screenshot
Screenshot.description: Choose a screenshot showing the post's comment section. OCR will extract the visible comments and add them to the shared list below. Check for recognition mistakes before running the main analysis.
Screenshot.screenshotPreviewAlt: Preview of the selected comment screenshot
Screenshot.invalidImage: Choose a PNG, JPEG, WEBP, or another image file.
Screenshot.fileTooLarge: The comment screenshot must be 12 MB or smaller.
Screenshot.ocrFailed: The screenshot could not be read. Try a clearer screenshot cropped to the comment section.
Screenshot.processingFailed: The screenshot could not be processed. Please retry.
Screenshot.invalidResponse: The screenshot response did not contain extracted comments.
Screenshot.noneExtracted: No comments were extracted from this screenshot.
Screenshot.noCommentsHint: No comments were recognized. Try a clearer screenshot that shows the comment text at a larger size.
Screenshot.extractedSummary: Recognized {count, plural, one {# comment} other {# comments}} and added them to the list below. Duplicates are skipped, and the list holds up to 30 comments. Review and correct the results.

Errors.maxImages: You can upload a maximum of 2 images.
Errors.imagesTooLarge: Images must be under 2 MB total.
Errors.readImageFailed: Could not read the selected image.
Errors.analysisUnavailable: Analysis is unavailable. Check that the backend is running and try again.

Report.title: Final Analysis Report / 综合分析报告
Report.missingAuthorship: Not enough text to assess AI-writing signals
Report.missingLayer3: Not enough comments to assess comment coordination
Report.missingLayer4: No post images to assess image-text consistency

ReferenceTool.title: Image Reference Check (Separate Tool)
ReferenceTool.description: Use this only when you have both an image to check and its trusted original. This compares those two images; it is separate from the post analysis above.
ReferenceTool.workflowHint: Choose the image you want to check on the left and its trusted original on the right. Then select Compare Images.
ReferenceTool.targetDescription: Choose the image you want to inspect.
ReferenceTool.referenceDescription: Choose the trusted original version of the same image.
ReferenceTool.targetPreviewAlt: Preview of the image to check
ReferenceTool.selectBothImages: Choose both the image to check and its trusted original.
ReferenceTool.fileTooLarge: Each image must be 12 MB or smaller.
ReferenceTool.comparisonFailed: Image comparison failed. Check that the service is running and try again.
ReferenceTool.invalidResponse: No valid comparison result was returned. Please retry.
ReferenceTool.resultHint: This is the model output. Review it alongside the images and other evidence; it cannot by itself prove that an image was changed or establish anyone's intent.
